title: Leg (tour de jeu) — v4.0.0, spec 007-contextual-game-turns (supersedes v3.0.0 of spec 006, v2.0.0 of spec 005)
description: Each leg is persisted as leg-{NNN}-{playerSlug}.json inside the atelier folder. v4 (spec 007): additive `votes` array of structured VoteDecision objects (FR-010). v3 fields (turnIndex, majorSuit, suitId, cardValue, points) and v2 fields (entries replacing legacy precisions) are unchanged. LEGACY READ: v1 `precisions: [string]` still converts to PRECISION entries with author "inconnu" (R-036 spec 005); missing `votes` reads as an empty array.

entries.description: Structured entries of the turn (spec 005 v2): PRECISION and QUESTION objects with knows/answer

votes.description: Spec 007 v4: per-voter structured vote decisions (FR-009/FR-010). Empty for legacy legs.
